# T8 evals — shell steps back: one nav, one assistant entry, nothing overlapping

Spec file: `e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts`, first line `test.use({ channel: "chrome" });`. Run: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts` (mock server 3201 started by playwright.config.ts). Contract selectors the builder must expose: `data-testid="page-subtabs"` (sub-tab nav), `data-testid="ask-fab"` (Ask Knowvia control), `data-testid="trial-pill"` (trial notice), `data-testid="trial-pill-dismiss"` (its close button), `data-testid="page-breadcrumb"`, `data-testid="page-eyebrow"` (must not exist as duplicate of page name), `data-testid="main-content"`. Helper `overlaps(a,b)` = boxes intersect with positive area.

E1. Sub-tabs hidden on desktop — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E1 subtabs hidden at 1280"` — viewport 1280x800, goto /policies, assert `page-subtabs` `not.toBeVisible()` — PASS if exit 0.

E2. Sub-tabs shown on mobile — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E2 subtabs shown at 390"` — viewport 390x844, /policies, assert `page-subtabs` `toBeVisible()` — PASS if exit 0. Also at 1099x800 visible, at 1100x800 hidden (boundary).

E3. Breadcrumb only, no duplicate eyebrow — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E3 no duplicate eyebrow"` — at 1280 on /policies, /tools, /home: `page-breadcrumb` visible; no element with `page-eyebrow` whose text equals the page h1 text (case-insensitive); page name text appears at most once outside the sidebar and breadcrumb (h1) — PASS if exit 0.

E4. Emergency red group — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E4 emergency signal color"` — goto /emergency; computed `color`/`background-color` of the sidebar Emergency item's group and the page's header/group accent resolve to the same value as `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--signal')` (resolved to rgb) — PASS if exit 0 and both match.

E5. Ask control absent on /chat — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E5 ask hidden on chat"` — goto /chat at 1280 and 390, assert `ask-fab` count 0 or not visible; on /home it is visible (sanity) — PASS if exit 0.

E6. Ask control geometry at 1280 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E6 ask geometry"` — 1280x800 on /home: boundingBox width === 56 and height === 56; `1280 - (x+width)` in [0,24]; `800 - (y+height)` in [0,24] — PASS if exit 0.

E7. Ask control never overlaps input/textarea/select/button, 1280 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E7 no overlap 1280"` — for each of /home, /tools, /covers/add, /policies: collect boxes of every visible `input, textarea, select, button` excluding the ask control itself and its descendants; also repeat after scrolling to page bottom; assert no intersection with positive area — PASS if exit 0 and 0 intersections on all 4 routes.

E8. Same at 390 — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E8 no overlap 390"` — identical to E7 at 390x844, including after scroll to bottom — PASS if exit 0.

E9. Main bottom padding clears Ask control — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E9 bottom padding"` — at 1280 and 390 on /home: computed `padding-bottom` of `main-content` >= 56 + 24 px (80); scrolled to bottom, last content element bottom edge <= Ask control top — PASS if exit 0.

E10. Trial pill compact, dismissible, persists — cmd: `npx playwright test e2e/t8-shell.spec.ts -g "E10 trial pill"` — with trial session in mock: `trial-pill` visible on /home, height <= 40px; click `trial-pill-dismiss`, pill hidden; `page.reload()` and navigate to /tools: still hidden — PASS if exit 0. Failure path: before dismiss, a fresh context shows the pill again.

E11. Theme lock — cmd: `git fetch origin main && git diff origin/main -- src/styles/tokens.css | wc -c` — expect output `0` — PASS if output is exactly 0.

E12. verify — cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if exit 0.
